scores.decision_correct_quote: Q1: No. Minimum: parent watchdog (no `triagecrm:prechat-complete` → error + PostHog/Sentry, not zoom); eager-load or modulepreload `_token`; fix `buildDemoWelcome`; pass `tools` on the follow-up completion; nginx `widget GET` without init.

must_catch.quote: After a native tool call, the follow-up completion omits `tools`, which Anthropic/LiteLLM 400s; the widget still 200s a canned fallback — tests fake this call and cannot catch it.
Demo welcome always appends “ practice” to the template name, so `psychology-practice` → “psychology practice practice.”

Silent prospect-facing failures and cheapest detectors: (1) widget GET without `_token` or init — nginx dead-man 15s + parent timeout event; (2) C7 follow-up — grep `LLM follow-up call failed`; (3) share JSON append — grep `[demo-share] Failed to record message` or share GET `messages: 0` after a 200 chat; (4) PostHog `screenshot_success` without `live_preview_widget_init`.

false_objections.quote: Lazy `$token` chunk never `import()`’d after the 1293 B shell + entry chunks
false_objections.why: the captures establish missing requests but cannot establish the claimed JavaScript mechanism

false_objections.quote: nothing in the widget ever signals "ready"
false_objections.why: the rubric identifies `live_preview_widget_init` as the honest init signal

false_objections.quote: parent watchdog (no `triagecrm:prechat-complete` → error + PostHog/Sentry, not zoom)
false_objections.why: the animation-timer signal can satisfy this watchdog while init is hung

false_objections.quote: The demo's first sentence is grammatically broken for all six verticals.
false_objections.why: the verified duplicated-word defect affects two verticals rather than all six

scores.notes: The union correctly rejects fitness and catches the tools omission, duplicated welcome wording, and silent-failure detectors, but misses the two severest blockers, the init-signal trap, and the required decide-after-check qualification.
